anya: Quick heads-up — opened docs PR #3142 for SDK snippet cleanup (py/ts/go) around streaming + pagination + retry behavior. Need a quick review on the async iterator migration note and a small TS resume-token example.

sam: link? and CI status?

anya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3142 — CI is green, deploy preview up, but preview shows the TS example doesn't show how to resume a paginated stream (customers confused).

jordan: I can take the Python snippet. Where do we want the resume semantics to live — under "Streaming + Pagination" or in "Advanced patterns / Resuming"?

anya: Put it in Streaming + Pagination. Customers search for "resume token" there. Also add a short callout about backpressure and retry idempotency (do not retry mid-stream; restart from resume_token).

kim: tiny nit: the docs link in the sidebar is currently pointing to `/sdk` but the reference page is under `/sdk/reference` — I'll fix that in the PR.

docs-bot: deploy preview available at https://deploy-preview-3142--docs.redwood.ai :rocket:

sam: sketching Python async generator to show resume semantics:

```py
async def stream_pages(client, start_cursor=None):
    cursor = start_cursor
    while True:
        resp = await client.streaming.list_items(page_cursor=cursor)
        async for item in resp:
            yield item
        # after iteration resp exposes a resume token if more pages exist
        cursor = getattr(resp, "resume_token", None)
        if not cursor:
            break
```

Note: emphasize that `resp.resume_token` is only available once the page has been fully emitted.

jordan: For Go I prefer explicit chunk callbacks to avoid buffering; I'll add a small example that uses a channel and a resume token loop.

kim: fixing the broken sidebar link + pushing a commit with the wording tweak about retries ("do not retry mid-stream; restart from resume token"), will also add a tiny cross-ref to the SDK reference.

anya: Awesome. If someone can add a concise TS snippet that shows the `resumeToken` access pattern and a one-line note about when to restart, I can merge after minor review.

sam: adding TS snippet now:

```ts
for await (const page of client.streaming.listPages({ pageCursor: startCursor })) {
  for (const rec of page) {
    process(rec)
  }
  // `page.resumeToken` exists once the page factory finishes emitting
  startCursor = (page as any).resumeToken
}
```

Comment: call out that you should not attempt to retry individual items mid-page; use the resume token to replay from the correct page boundary.
